title: Disparity Laundering: Consensus Without Fairness in Clinical Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.38215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical large language models are increasingly fielded as multi-agent teams, on the assumption that deliberation averages out individual error. It does not average out bias. Across a full factorial of five model families and four aggregation topologies on 120 real MIMIC-IV emergency cases under counterfactual demographic swaps, no configuration neutralizes the disparity: all 20 cells commit the direction of their agents' independent answers, giving Black patients more acute triage. Every model has a topology that amplifies its baseline gap, but which one varies by model, so no design is reliably safe or reliably amplifying: the disparity is relocated, never removed. Late-stage fixes fail: fairness instructions and demographic masking leave the gap untouched, and per-agent self-debiasing widens it, because the bias is already encoded in the agents' ordinary clinical numbers. translated_title: 差异洗白：临床多智能体系统中缺乏公平性的共识
translated_abstract: 临床大语言模型越来越多地被部署为多智能体团队，其前提假设是协商讨论可以平均消除个体误差，但它并不能平均消除偏见。在120个真实MIMIC-IV急诊病例上、于反事实人口属性交换条件下，对五种模型家族和四种聚合拓扑结构进行全因子实验后发现，没有任何配置能够中和这种差异：全部20种组合都会沿其智能体独立答案的方向作出判断，给黑人患者分配更紧急的分诊等级。每个模型都存在一种会放大其基线差距的拓扑结构，但具体是哪一种因模型而异，因此没有哪种设计是可靠安全的、也没有哪种是必然放大差距的：差异只是被转移，从未被消除。后期修复措施均告失败：公平性指令和人口属性掩蔽对差距毫无作用，而各智能体的自我去偏反而会扩大差距，因为偏见早已编码在智能体输出的常规临床数值之中。我们将这种现象称为“差异洗白”（disparity laundering）；目前应用于临床……
tldr: 研究通过对五种模型家族与四种聚合拓扑的全因子实验发现，临床多智能体LLM系统的协商机制无法消除偏见，反而会把各智能体的独立偏见“洗白”为集体共识（如给黑人患者更紧急的分诊），且公平指令、属性掩蔽等后期修复手段均告无效，作者将此现象命名为“差异洗白”。
en_tdlr: Through full factorial experiments across five model families and four aggregation topologies, this study shows that clinical multi-agent LLM systems fail to average out bias through deliberation—instead "laundering" agents' independent biases into collective consensus (assigning Black patients more acute triage)—while late-stage fixes like fairness instructions and demographic masking prove ineffective, a phenomenon the authors term "disparity laundering."
